entities.summary: The Al Tawheed Mosque is a mosque in Sana'a, Yemen. It lies in the eastern part of the city, southeast of Revolution Hospital and Alemaan Mosque, along the E Ring Road. The mosque was completed in 1359 AH (1940/1941 CE).
